hero.title:
Every card,

exactly where it belongs.
hero.subtitle: Mault recognizes your cards the moment you show them to a webcam, then sorts them into bins using rules you set - by rarity, color, set, type, or anything else. No spreadsheets, no guesswork.

supportedGames.heading: Sorts any TCG you throw at it
supportedGames.subtitle: New games get added to the sorter's database, not hard-coded into the app - here's what's live right now.

pipeline.heading: How it works
pipeline.subtitle: From loose pile to organized collection in four simple steps.

showCard.title: Show it a card
showCard.description: Hold any card up to your webcam - no scanner or app on your phone required.

recognized.title: It's recognized instantly
recognized.description: Mault matches it against the full card database in a moment, rarity, set and all.

sorted.title: Sorted by your rules
sorted.description: Set up rules once - by rarity, color, set, type, or anything else - and every card routes itself.

organized.title: Always organized
organized.description: Every card is logged and searchable, across as many collections as you keep.

features.heading: Everything you need to get organized
features.subtitle: Mault handles the sorting so you can spend more time playing and less time digging through boxes.

recognition.title: Instant recognition
recognition.description: No typing card names, no barcodes. Just show the card and Mault knows what it is.

rules.title: Rules you control
rules.description: Mix and match conditions - rarity, color, set, type and more - to route cards exactly where you want.

collections.title: Multiple collections
collections.description: Keep separate collections for trade binders, decks, or storage boxes, and switch between them freely.

insights.title: Know what you own
insights.description: See counts, rarities, and sets across your whole library - no more guessing what's in the box.

logging.title: Every card logged
logging.description: Each scan is saved automatically, so your collection stays accurate without extra bookkeeping.

hardware.title: Built for the table
hardware.description: Pairs with a physical sorter, so cards land in real bins - not just another spreadsheet. Add more sorting modules to expand up to 11 bins.

openSource.heading: Fully open source
openSource.subtitle: The software and the physical sorter are both free to build, inspect, and modify. Grab the code and print your own.

sourceCode.title: Source code
sourceCode.description: The web app, API, and Arduino firmware are all in one repo under an open license.

printableSorter.title: 3D printable sorter
printableSorter.description: Print the card sorter yourself - Fusion 360 and 3MF files are included in the repo.

community.title: Community
community.description: Join the Discord to share builds, get help, and talk to other people running their own sorter.

cta.heading: Stop shuffling. Start sorting.
cta.subtitle: Set up your first collection in minutes and let Mault keep it organized from here on out.
